title: Chocolate Mug Cake
description: A single-serve chocolate cake made in a mug, ready in under 2 minutes. Perfect for late-night cravings.

method.instruction: In a microwave-safe mug (350-400ml capacity), whisk together flour, sugar, cocoa powder, and baking powder.
Add egg, milk, vegetable oil, and vanilla extract. Stir with a fork until smooth and fully combined.
Fold in chocolate chips if using.
Microwave on high (800-1000W) for 75-90 seconds. The cake will rise and look slightly moist on top.
Let stand in the mug for 1 minute before eating. Serve directly from the mug.

notes.title: Microwave Power
notes.content: Start with 75 seconds, then add 10 seconds if needed. Overcooking makes it dry.

notes.title: Big Mug Needed
notes.content: Use a mug that holds at least 350ml. The cake rises significantly during cooking.

notes.title: Eggless Version
notes.content: Omit the egg and increase milk to 60ml and oil to 30ml.
